spots.name: Carter Wen
spots.text: Roadwolves hit the toll cart at dawn. If you go east, keep to the road. Forest is where they wait.
dialogue: 'I used to run the east road twice a week. Then the toll cart came back with its wheels still turning and no horses.'
'The wolves are not all beasts. Their chief pays deserters in silver and lets them keep whatever they can carry.'

spots.name: Village Guard
spots.text: Hask Gravelteeth's camp lies far to the east, past the old watchtower road. Bring more than three blades.
dialogue: 'The watchtower bell rings when the wind is from the north. Last night it rang with no wind at all.'
'If you find a brass token in the mud, don't spend it. The old road wardens used those to open the sealed storehouse.'

spots.name: Freed Debtor
spots.text: A traveller keeps a folded contract hidden beneath his coat.
spots.companion_quest_text: A former inmate shows Bram a contract with fees compounded after release and a signature copied from a dead witness. Compare the clauses and testimony: some debts are real, but these transfers are not lawful proof of what the prisoners owe.

spots.name: Muster Clerk
spots.text: A clerk has hidden an order beneath the town's old levy register.
spots.companion_quest_text: Anselm recognises the seal on a muster order dated after the ceasefire. Compare its authority and date before accepting the clerk's claim that the soldiers volunteered.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which detail proves the order cannot be treated as a lawful volunteer muster?
options: The order bears a campaign seal
The order is dated after the ceasefire and lacks a renewed levy warrant
The ink is faded
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The order is dated after the ceasefire and lacks a renewed levy warrant
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The dates and missing warrant establish that the unit was recalled without lawful authority.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The campaign seal alone does not establish authority after the ceasefire.

spots.name: Innkeeper Maud
spots.text: Rest your feet, captain. Beds are full of drovers tonight, but the stew is hot and the gossip is free.
dialogue: 'A warm bed buys a man one honest night. A good story buys the next three.'
'The drover in the corner lost his brother near the old tower. He says the stones whisper names after rain.'

spots.name: Drover
spots.text: Heard a purse was left in the old tower, north of here. Nobody dares go. The roads are not what they were.

spots.name: Chain Yard Witness
spots.text: A teamster has seen debtors marched toward a guarded work yard.
spots.companion_quest_text: The witness knows where the debtors are being held. Bram refuses to leave them behind. The evidence can support a public tribunal, a negotiated release that preserves the records, or the destruction of the false transfer papers before the company can use them again.

spots.name: Shopkeeper Oswin
spots.text: Blades, mail, charms and sigils, all honestly priced. And your company's kit can be sorted out right here at the counter.
dialogue: Oswin rubs a thumb over a scar in the counter. 'A rune is not a bauble. It remembers every hand that has carried it.'
'I can seat a rune safely, or draw one out without cracking the socket. A field swap is how good steel gets ruined.'
'Bring me three of the same mark for the Forge. Their grades need not match, but a well-trained rune gives the ritual a steadier chance.'

spots.name: Elder Hale
spots.text: House Dunmarrow held these roads for three hundred years. Torren, the keep is yours to rebuild. Start with the road to Eldrimar.

spots.name: Drill Sergeant
spots.text: A retired sergeant keeps a tally of the men who were ordered back to the yard.
spots.companion_quest_text: The drill tally lists men marked absent even when they were on approved leave. Anselm asks you to compare the muster column with the leave marks.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which record best confirms that the roll was falsified?
options: A matching leave mark beside a man recorded absent
A missing boot from the rack
A second copy of the same tally
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A matching leave mark beside a man recorded absent
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The approved leave marks contradict the absent entries and expose the false count.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A second copy may repeat the same error; it does not independently verify the men.

spots.name: Gate Warden
spots.text: The walls are cracked, but they hold. Steward Brannoch is waiting in the great hall.

spots.name: Steward Brannoch
spots.text: The road is open, my lord, but it is not safe. Train the company, forge sigils, and clear the Roadwolf Camp.
dialogue: 'Your house held this valley by oath, not by walls. Walls can be raised again; trust takes longer.'
'The quartermaster has sent word of a smith at the lower gate. He can temper any weapon or piece of armor to +15, though the price rises with every strike.'
'The old families kept heirloom runes apart from common stock. They are not merchandise. They choose their bearer.'

spots.name: War Table
spots.text: The war table: sort your company, gear, sigils and promotions here, or send for the market stock.
dialogue: 'Scouts have marked three approaches: river, ridge and forest. Each battlefield will answer differently to the ground beneath your boots.'
'Take the high ground where you can. A narrow ford is a fine place to hold a line, and a poor place to retreat.'

spots.name: Master Smith Rurik
spots.text: Rurik's arms are black with forge soot. He measures every blade as if it were a promise.
dialogue: 'Steel has a memory. Every temper leaves a little of the smith in it.'
'I can improve a weapon or armor to +15. I can also draw socketed runes without damaging them. Nothing is free but advice.'

spots.name: Furnace Broker
spots.text: A well-dressed broker waits beside a sealed crate of furnace fittings.
spots.companion_quest_text: The former employer offers Edda the workshop if she signs away the workers' claims. With the tool register and wage testimony in hand, she can reject the bargain, establish shared rules, or take ownership only with binding worker protections.

spots.name: Former Spearman
spots.text: A former soldier waits beside the hall's public notice board.
spots.companion_quest_text: The men confirm they were threatened with forfeited pay if they refused the recalled muster. Hear their account before deciding whether Anselm should testify, offer a lawful compact or refuse to rebuild the unit.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: What makes the soldiers' testimony credible?
options: Every account repeats the same exact phrase
Their separate pay records and leave marks corroborate the threat
The officer says the order was routine
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Their separate pay records and leave marks corroborate the threat
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: Independent records support the soldiers' accounts and establish a pattern of coercion.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A repeated phrase can be coached, and the officer's assertion is not evidence.

spots.name: Sergeant Voss
spots.text: Spears sharp, boots dry. Give the word and we march. Rear attacks and flanks win fights, captain. Remember it.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Signal Keeper's Assistant
spots.text: A cracked brass signal plate lies beneath the old watch notice.
spots.companion_quest_text: Lucan recognises the Orrowen signal code. Someone used the old flight pattern after the garrison was supposedly disbanded. He asks you to preserve the plate before the patrol clerk removes it.

spots.name: Convoy Survivor
spots.text: A survivor carries a splintered bolt recovered from the convoy road.
spots.companion_quest_text: Dorian recognises the fletching on the bolt. Compare its maker's mark with the convoy inventory to establish which shipment was attacked.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which clue reliably identifies the diverted convoy?
options: The maker's mark matched to the dated quartermaster inventory
The survivor's guess about the weather
A generic military stamp
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The maker's mark matched to the dated quartermaster inventory
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The maker's mark links the bolt to a specific issue batch in the convoy inventory.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Weather and a generic stamp cannot identify a particular shipment.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: A clean bed and a hot meal cost 20 gold. Your company can recover its nerve here.

spots.name: Retired Road Scout
spots.text: The scout keeps a folded route map beneath his cup.
spots.companion_quest_text: The scout remembers a patrol that moved without horses and avoided the main road. Lucan lays the signal timings beside the route notes.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: The signal plate records a dusk flash, then a second flash from the western ridge. The patrol left no hoofprints. Which route best fits the evidence?
options: The west ridge footpath after dusk
The southern cart road at noon
The river ford before sunrise
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The west ridge footpath after dusk
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The timings and lack of hoofprints match a foot patrol on the west ridge. Lucan marks the route and identifies the deserters' likely passage.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: That route conflicts with either the signal timing or the missing hoofprints. Compare both clues before choosing.

spots.name: Roadside Fletcher
spots.text: A fletcher remembers repairing the same bolt pattern before the ambush.
spots.companion_quest_text: The fletcher's repair record and the road's impact marks allow Dorian to reconstruct the shot. Determine which trajectory matches the physical evidence.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which reconstruction fits the recovered evidence?
options: A shot from the raised western bank matching the impact angle
A shot fired straight down from the road
A bolt launched from inside the convoy wagon
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A shot from the raised western bank matching the impact angle
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The angle and recovered splinter pattern point to the raised western bank.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The other trajectories contradict the impact angle and wood damage.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The Weald's best bowyers and charm-sellers trade here. Use the party counter to compare and buy equipment.

spots.name: Former Garrison Clerk
spots.text: A former clerk asks for a private hearing before the market opens.
spots.companion_quest_text: The clerk confirms that the deserters carried the pay chest away, but also names a family who sheltered them under threat. Lucan asks you to hear the witness without turning their fear into another accusation.

spots.name: Quartermaster's Runner
spots.text: A runner has a duplicate tally of the missing convoy supplies.
spots.companion_quest_text: The duplicate tally shows that the quartermaster removed supplies before the ambush. Dorian must confront him with the record and decide whether to testify, make restitution or decline public absolution.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which record ties the quartermaster to the diversion?
options: A signed issue-and-return tally with a false return entry
An unsigned market rumour
A damaged wagon wheel
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A signed issue-and-return tally with a false return entry
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The signed tally records the quartermaster's custody and the false return.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The rumour and damaged wheel do not establish who diverted the supplies.

spots.name: Lucan Thorne
spots.text: A steady yeoman captain, once sworn to House Orrowen. He will travel with you if you can offer a place in the company.

spots.name: Joss Harrow
spots.text: A quick-handed smuggler who knows every back room between the coast and the March. He asks for 50 gold and a chance to choose his own risks.

spots.name: Tomas Wren
spots.text: A fearless young messenger who has outrun three patrols. He wants a company that will let him prove himself.

spots.name: Verra Nightsong
spots.text: A singer with a spy's memory and a diplomat's smile. She will only trust a company that has already earned Joss Harrow's confidence.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.
spots.companion_quest_text: Brisa recognises the old village register beneath the crier's notices. Several displaced families were erased when the temporary infirmary closed. She asks you to recover the ledger before its names are lost.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The herbwives keep a quiet room for weary travellers. Rest costs 20 gold.
spots.companion_quest_text: The innkeeper remembers three families who sheltered in the upper rooms. Brisa compares their accounts with the recovered ledger. Their needs differ: one needs medicine, one needs a safe room, and one needs a way home.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Brisa lays out three testimonies. Mira needs a safe room, Pell needs medicine, and Oren's family cannot travel home without an escort. Which request is specifically a medical emergency?
options: Mira needs a safe room
Pell needs medicine
Oren needs an escort
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: You match Pell's fever notes to the infirmary ledger. Brisa can now assign a healer without exposing the other families.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: That testimony describes shelter or safe passage, not the urgent medical need. Read the three accounts again.

spots.name: Foundry Hand
spots.text: A soot-streaked worker warms both hands around a cup and watches the door.
spots.companion_quest_text: The foundry hand names the workers who paid for the missing tools through withheld wages. Edda listens to each account and separates verified claims from rumour. The workers want their names and wages recorded before anyone bargains over the furnace.

spots.name: Recovered Patient
spots.text: A patient remembers the date the ward changed its draught.
spots.companion_quest_text: Petra checks the patient's account against the surviving sample and the apothecary's dated batch notes. Verify which evidence confirms the treatment was diluted.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: What verifies the patient's account without relying on memory alone?
options: A matching batch note and a sealed sample analysis
A rumour repeated by another patient
The ward's painted sign
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A matching batch note and a sealed sample analysis
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The dated batch note and sealed sample independently corroborate the patient's recollection.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: A repeated rumour and a sign cannot verify the contents of a batch.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Foxglove trades in herbs, bows and travel gear. The quartermaster can arrange your equipment.
spots.companion_quest_text: The market factor offers a practical solution: a rotating care network, with supplies shared between households. Brisa asks you to choose how Foxglove will remember and care for its displaced families.

spots.name: Apothecary's Ledger Keeper
spots.text: A ledger keeper has kept a copy of the ward's medicine receipts.
spots.companion_quest_text: Petra finds a discrepancy between the ward's full-strength medicine charges and the diluted doses patients received. Identify the record that can establish the discrepancy.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which comparison is the strongest evidence of false billing?
options: The invoice quantities against the signed dispensing register
The colour of the medicine bottle
The ward's public donation board
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: The invoice quantities against the signed dispensing register
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The signed dispensing register shows what was actually issued, allowing the invoices to be checked.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Bottle colour and donation totals do not establish the medicine dispensed.

spots.name: Old Brisa
spots.text: A village elder and healer. She asks no oath, only that the company protect the road folk.

spots.name: Edda Stonehand
spots.text: A blunt siege-wright from Brennhallow. She is searching for proof that the old tollhouse stores can supply a rebuilt workshop.

spots.name: Bram Cullen
spots.text: A gentle giant with a pit-fighter's scars. The camp must be cleared before he will risk joining another armed company.

spots.name: Foundry Tool Clerk
spots.text: A clerk keeps the foundry's tool register beneath a stack of unpaid invoices.
spots.companion_quest_text: Edda checks the old foundry register. Several specialist tools were charged to workers who never received them; others were loaned freely and must not be counted as theft. Compare the marks and identify what is truly missing.

spots.name: Debt Runner
spots.text: A frightened courier carries a transfer notice stamped by a private debt company.
spots.companion_quest_text: Bram Cullen recognises the jailer's mark on the transfer notice. His prison debt has been sold to a private company, along with claims against several other inmates. He asks you to trace the contract before the company can move them.

spots.name: Ward's Former Steward
spots.text: The former steward offers Petra the last page of the triage register.
spots.companion_quest_text: The triage register confirms that vulnerable patients were given priority only on paper. Petra must decide how to expose the error while protecting those who could be harmed by public disclosure.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: Which approach preserves accountability while minimising harm to patients?
options: Publish every patient's name
Destroy the register
Publish verified treatment records with patient identities redacted
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: Publish verified treatment records with patient identities redacted
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: A redacted record preserves the evidence while protecting patients' identities.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: Publishing names risks further harm; destroying the register removes the proof.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Carved Waystone
spots.text: A tiny hooked mark has been cut into the underside of the waystone.
spots.companion_quest_text: Kestrel spots a contract mark used by their former handlers. It points to a safehouse where names were traded for patrol routes. Kestrel asks you not to touch the mark until its pattern is copied.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The timber hall offers a dry bed and a warm fire for 20 gold.

spots.name: Safehouse Caretaker
spots.text: The caretaker's ledger has been scraped clean, but the pressure marks remain.
spots.companion_quest_text: Kestrel reconstructs the hidden entries from the paper grooves. The safehouse used three signs to warn its occupants.

companion_quest_challenge.prompt: The caretaker says the warning was never a spoken password. Which sign would tell a fugitive that watchers were waiting outside?
options: A lantern turned toward the street
A shutter left open on the upper floor
A bucket placed beside the rear step
companion_quest_challenge.correct_option: A lantern turned toward the street
companion_quest_challenge.success_text: The lantern mark matches the hidden ledger notation. Kestrel finds the watcher schedule and the list of names sold to the patrol.
companion_quest_challenge.failure_text: The caretaker shakes their head. That sign was ordinary household business, not the warning used by the handlers.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Carpenters and hunters bring their wares to the square. The factor can open your company stores.

spots.name: Protected Witness
spots.text: A courier waits among the timber merchants, carrying a sealed statement.
spots.companion_quest_text: The witness can identify the handler who sold the names, but revealing them would expose the safehouse families. Kestrel asks you to protect the witness before deciding what the records should become.

spots.name: Kestrel
spots.text: A silent scout with an old contract to settle. A place among your outriders will do.

spots.name: Lady Isaure Vessmoor
spots.text: A proud heir stripped of her lands. She will speak after the Vessmoor gate is opened and the road is safe.

spots.name: Ser Willem Roake
spots.text: A disciplined duelist who accepts no commander lightly. He follows only after Lady Isaure has joined.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Red Mare charges 20 gold for a night's rest and a stable for your mounts.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The central market carries Vessmoor steel, tack and provisions. Visit the counter to manage your gear.

spots.name: Anselm Pike
spots.text: A veteran sergeant with a dry wit and a gift for keeping recruits alive. He will join a disciplined company.

spots.name: Garrick Holt
spots.text: A defeated heavy-knight commander. Spare the Catacombs' guardian and prove that honour can outlive defeat.

spots.name: Lord Corwin Brennhallow
spots.text: The Regent's conflicted son. He will not leave the capital before the fourth act begins.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Ferry House offers a meal and a bed for 20 gold.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Ferry traders sell river gear and imported goods. The factor can access your party shop.

spots.name: Petra Quill
spots.text: A blunt field surgeon who left a noble household after refusing to abandon wounded levies.

spots.name: Sister Odalys
spots.text: A former inquisitor seeking atonement. She asks that the Kingsroad Catacombs be cleansed before she takes up arms again.

spots.name: Seraphine Tarnholt
spots.text: A healer-knight whose faith has survived too many failures. Her story begins in the fourth act.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Garrison Inn provides a guarded room for 20 gold.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The mile market stocks practical arms and armour for the southern road.

spots.name: Dorian Vask
spots.text: A pragmatic mercenary captain. He asks for a fair share and a clear chain of command.

spots.name: Orlan Pike
spots.text: An exiled fire scholar who waits for the Bell Under Leaves to fall silent before returning to the field.

spots.name: Ysolde Marrow
spots.text: A strategic ice mage and merchant's daughter. She joins after Verra's negotiations open the Ysmark route.

spots.name: Ilyan Voss
spots.text: A former tower guard turned battle mage. His loyalty is pledged to the later campaign, not a passing contract.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A rusted strongbox contains 120 gold and a map fragment. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Rootbound Warden
spots.text: A former road captain has become the keeper of this den. He has chained the old tunnel doors and refuses to let the dead rest.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A votive coffer holds 120 gold and a silver woodland token. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Bell-Keeper
spots.text: The last keeper guards the bronze bell, convinced its toll is the only thing keeping a buried plague asleep.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A sealed royal chest contains 120 gold and a signet fragment. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Ashen Reeve
spots.text: A disgraced Vessmoor reeve commands the ossuary's looters, claiming the crown still owes his family a debt.

spots.name: Captain Ilyra Venn
spots.text: The Assembly calls this a port. The sailors call it the last honest light before the black current. Three beacon crews vanished in one month.
dialogue: A sealed lighthouse ledger was carried into Tideglass Grotto before the last keeper disappeared.
Bring the ledger back intact. I will put the truth before the Assembly, even if it costs me my chair.

spots.name: Tidebound Factor
spots.text: Charts, rope, salt-proof mail and provisions. No one sails the outer shoals without a proper line.

spots.name: Maren Vey
spots.text: A quiet pilot who knows the reefs by the sound of water against stone. Maren will only sail with a company that brings the Tideglass ledger back.

spots.name: The Lantern & Keel
spots.text: A warm room above the tide stairs. The keeper serves fish stew and keeps a dry chart table.

spots.name: Net-mender Ossa
spots.text: The tide pools have gone quiet. Even the gulls avoid the northern rocks. My brother saw lanterns moving under the water.

spots.name: The Brackish Cup
spots.text: The keeper offers a dry bed and a bowl of hot shellfish broth.

spots.name: Beacon Apprentice
spots.text: The old signal lens was removed three nights before the beacon went dark. The official log says it was never there.

spots.name: Quay Provisioner
spots.text: Fresh rope, lamp oil and travel gear for the coast road.

spots.name: Keeper's Strongbox
spots.text: Inside is a salt-stained chart and the missing lighthouse ledger. The last page bears the Seven Flames seal, deliberately scraped away.

spots.name: The Reef Warden
spots.text: A former beacon guard stands between you and the outer chamber. He has been ordered to keep the ledger buried, but his hands shake when he sees the seal.
